newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.6125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.6125 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Wednesday, August 20, was fixed at 20.6125 percent, or a rise of 5.75 basis points from 20.5550 percent, the rate for August 19, Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Wednesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
